methodology: PCVR Radar readiness: documented controller support (35), installation path (25), public installation guide (20), dated release within 365 days (15), and documented runtime requirements (5). A 85–100, B 70–84, C 50–69, D below 50. A grade is withheld unless three independent facts are documented; this is not a review score.
notes: These are curated links to mod developers' published documentation. They are not UnflatVR grades, PCVR Central quality ratings, or independent hands-on tests. Missing documentation means Not assessed, not low quality.

circuitlord/circuitlordvrmodinstaller.runtime: OpenXR; Steam, EA or Xbox game installation
circuitlord/circuitlordvrmodinstaller.note: Official installer documents Titanfall 2 VR, 6DOF controllers, supported install sources and a separate TF2VR profile. Installer repository also covers another title; release dates must be attributed to the specific mod.

raicuparta/nomai-vr.note: Author documents 6DOF controls and mod-manager plus manual installation. Linux/Proton support remains unverified.

okabintaro/submersedvr.note: Author documents full motion-controller aim and setup. More manual steps than a one-click installer. Linux/Proton support not independently tested.
